title: Primary CTA · rainbow ring pill
description: Pill button with a 1.5 px rainbow gradient ring (cyan → orange → magenta, 249.99deg base, flips to 264.85deg on hover) and a sparkle star icon that rotates 180° on hover. The outer hover glow is tinted by the current vertical's --cta-accent token (cyan default; lawn-care → green; hvac → orange; etc). Uses the same tight bottom-centered radial hover glow as cta.btn-secondary-filled.

source.harmonized: PM lock 2026-05-22 — gradient direction matches sw + winter-services exactly. Image-based bottom glow is no longer used; reproduced via effect.hover-rise (pure CSS).

params.description: Sparkle ✦ on the left. Set to none for icon-less CTAs.

notes: Rainbow ring gradient flips 249.99deg → 264.85deg on hover (matches sw + winter-services exactly).
Outer hover glow uses var(--cta-accent) — page can re-theme via <body data-vertical="lawn-care"> etc.

Inner bottom glow intentionally matches cta.btn-secondary-filled: a calm 58% bottom-centered radial glow fading in on hover. This overrides the broader shared hover-rise strip when effect.hover-rise is also loaded.
On dark surfaces, override --button-primary-color to var(--color-white). The ring stays the same.
